label: Rain
description: Fills the bound solid's volume with falling rain streaks: stateless particle billboards seeded in a slab above the shape, falling straight down with a slight wind shear. A particle-only effect — bind an Appearance (Object or Instance scope) to a solid enclosing the region to rain on; the solid itself keeps rendering normally. Param_Fall sets the fall distance, Param_Size the streak length (model units).
